This is hymn number 20 titled "God of Power, God of Right" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Tracy Y. Cannon and the lyrics were written by Wallace F. Bennett.
